objectives.statement: Recognize what common pragmatic markers add beyond the literal sentence meaning.
Choose pragmatic markers in context to manage implication, politeness, evaluation, and topic movement.
Use evaluative sentence adverbs and extraposed attitude markers to show stance toward a whole situation.
Place discourse markers appropriately and avoid register mismatches in modern Bokmål.

notes: Late-B2 pragmatic-control capstone. Keep as a standalone lesson only because it combines social meaning across whole utterances: implication, politeness, evaluative sentence adverbs, extraposed attitude markers, side notes, and topic movement. Do not reteach modal-verb meanings from modal_nuance or the full uncertainty/source system from hedging_stance_markers; refer to jo/vel/nok only as pragmatic signals in context.
